bio: Antonio Corfiote stands as testament to the potential for advancement in La Serenissima. Born to Greek immigrants who fled Ottoman expansion, he transformed from a calloused dockworker to a prosperous warehouse proprietor through relentless perseverance. His once-weathered hands now bear the marks of success - fine cloth sleeves and an occasional gold ring - though he maintains the practical demeanor of one who knows the weight of every crate and value of every cargo.
